Simulate data for a Royle-Nichols model with false positives

Source: R/simulate_fp_rn.R
simulate_fp_rn.Rd

Generates one dataset from the model of fp_occu_rn(): Poisson abundance with a covariate and optional site effect, per-individual detection with an optional site effect, false positives on every automated occasion, verified occasions at a share of the sites, and, optionally, confirmed automated occasions (observation-confirmation design).

Usage

simulate_fp_rn(
  nsite = 200,
  nocc = 10,
  psi = 0.6,
  b1 = 0.5,
  r = 0.3,
  p10 = 0.05,
  sigma_r = 0,
  sigma_lam = 0,
  rv = 0.5,
  frac_verified = 0.3,
  nver = 3,
  frac_confirmed = 0,
  seed = NULL
)

Arguments

nsite

Number of sites.

nocc

Number of automated occasions per site: one number, or one per site (unbalanced designs).

psi

Occupancy probability at the mean of the covariate x; the intercept of log abundance is \(\log(-\log(1 - \psi))\).

b1

Slope of log abundance on the standardized covariate x.

r

Per-individual detection probability of the automated method.

p10

False-positive probability of the automated method.

sigma_r

Standard deviation of a site effect on the logit of r.

sigma_lam

Standard deviation of a site effect on log abundance.

rv

Per-individual detection probability of the verified method.

frac_verified

Probability that a site has verified occasions.

nver

Number of verified occasions per verified site.

frac_confirmed

Probability that an automated occasion is confirmed; 1 confirms every occasion, as in a fully annotated survey.

seed

Optional integer seed.

Value

A list of class fp_sim with elements data (an fp_data object; sites holds x) and truth (the generating values, the intercepts b0 of log abundance and a0 of the logit of r, the mean true-detection probability at occupied sites p11, the abundances N, the states z and the site effects).

Details

On each automated occasion a true observation occurs with probability \(1 - (1 - r_i)^{N_i}\) and a false one with probability p10, independently; the occasion is a detection if either occurs. Confirmed occasions get the columns n_true and n_false of auto (0 or 1, NA elsewhere). A verified occasion is a detection with probability \(1 - (1 - r^v)^{N_i}\).

See also

fp_occu_rn(), simulate_fp()

Examples

s <- simulate_fp_rn(nsite = 50, nocc = 10, sigma_r = 1, seed = 1)
s
#> <fp_sim> Royle-Nichols false positives
#>   truth: psi = 0.60, b1 = 0.50, p11 = 0.46, p10 = 0.050 (realized mean 0.050), r11 = 0.50
#>   realized occupancy: 0.62
#> <fp_data>
#>   sites:                  50
#>   automated occasions:    500 (naive occupancy 0.76)
#>   verified sites:         13 (39 occasions; verified detections at 6 sites)
#>   sites known occupied:   6
#>   site covariates:        x
